content: The job of the function NvM_WriteAll shall skip an NVRAM block if the NvMBlockUseCRCCompMechanism attribute is set to true and the RAM block CRC calculated by the write job is equal to the CRC calculated during the last successful read or write job. This mechanism shall not be applied to bloc ks for which a loss of redundancy has been detected.
